ui.Talk with someone anywhere: send them a: Vugana n'umuntu aho ari hose: mwoherereze ihuza (cyangwa werekane kode). Ashobora gukoresha telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa iyo ari yo yose, cyangwa TexCom ye. Ni wowe uhitamo uwinjira. Mwembi mukeneye murandasi.
ui.TexCom can’t use the microphone. Allow M: TexCom ntishobora gukoresha mikoro. Emerera TexCom Mikoro no Kumenya Imvugo mu Igenamiterere.
ui.TexCom couldn’t get the {language} phras: TexCom ntiyashoboye kubona interuro z'{language}. Zikenera murandasi ubwa mbere.
ui.TexCom couldn’t save your phrases (the s: TexCom ntiyashoboye kubika interuro zawe (ububiko bwuzuye). Impinduka yawe ya nyuma ishobora gutakara TexCom ifunze. Bika urutonde rw'interuro zawe muri dosiye mu Igenamiterere > Amakuru.
TexCom irimo gukoresha interuro zawe z'{language}.
ui.That conversation isn’t open. Ask for a: Icyo kiganiro ntigifunguye. Saba ihuza rishya.

ui.The features below run privately on the: Ibiranga biri hepfo bikorera mu ibanga ku gikoresho, bityo bikenera porogaramu ya TexCom ya iPhone, iPad, Mac cyangwa Android. Ntibiboneka muri mushakisha.
ui.The phrases it replaced are in Settings: Interuro yasimbuye ziri mu Igenamiterere > Amakuru > Garura interuro zabanje.
ui.There isn’t room to keep a copy of your: Nta mwanya wo kubika kopi y'interuro zawe z'ubu, bityo ntizasimbuwe. Banza uzibike muri dosiye (Igenamiterere > Amakuru).
ui.There’s no {language} voice on this devi: Nta jwi ry'{language} riri kuri iki gikoresho, bityo TexCom izasoma n'ijwi ifite. Ushobora kongeramo amajwi mu igenamiterere ry'igikoresho (Uburyo bwo Kugerwaho > Ibivugwa cyangwa Imvugo).
ui.They become your {language} phrases, to: Izi zihinduka interuro zawe z'{language}, ngo uzihindure uko ushaka. Interuro zawe z'{current} ziguma uko ziri: garuka igihe cyose.
ui.They were translated by machine and have: Izi zahinduwe n'imashini kandi ntiziragenzurwa n'uvuga {language}.
ui.This conversation isn’t open. Ask for a: Iki kiganiro ntigifunguye. Saba ihuza rishya.
ui.This device can’t listen in {language},: Iki gikoresho ntigishobora kumva mu {language}, bityo mikoro yumva mu rurimi rwabanje.
ui.This link is incomplete. Ask for the lin: Iri huza ntiryuzuye. Ongera usabe ihuza.

help.help_2: TexCom igufasha kuvuga wandika cyangwa uhitamo interuro yiteguye, kandi irabivuga mu ijwi riranguruye.
help.help_3: Urimo ukoresha TexCom muri mushakisha y'urubuga. Ibintu byose hano birakora usibye ibiranga porogaramu gusa, zikeneye porogaramu ya TexCom ya iPhone, iPad cyangwa Mac.
help.help_14: Kanda interuro kugirango uyongere ku gasanduku, hanyuma ukande Vuga. Urashobora kongeramo interuro nyinshi, cyangwa wandike byinshi hafi yazo.
help.help_15: Amagambo amwe yashizweho kugirango vuga ako kanya iyo uyakanze ("Ubutumwa bwihuse", reba Guhindura).
help.help_16: Agasanduku kanditse nako gushakisha. Mugihe wanditse, urutonde rwerekana interuro zirimo amagambo kuva aho uheruka guhagarara, koma, ikimenyetso cyibibazo (nibindi). Kanda imwe hanyuma isimbuze ayo magambo. Kurugero, andika Ndarushye. icyayi hanyuma ukande "Ntabwo ari igikombe cyanjye cy'icyayi." A Guhuza umurongo werekana mugihe urutonde rwungurujwe; kanda ✕ kugirango ubone interuro yose.
help.help_17: Amagambo ahinnye: andika interuro ihinnye ikurikirwa na / hanyuma ihinduka interuro yose. Kurugero, niba "Mwaramutse" ifite shortcut h, wandika h / itanga "Mwaramutse".
help.help_18: Imvugo ikubiyemo [***] ishyira izina ryawe (Igenamiterere> Izina ryawe).
help.help_20: Kuri ecran ifunganye buto zimwe zimuka muri menu ya ⋯ kumpera yumurongo wibikoresho.
help.help_26: Umva umukunzi wawe: azimya mikoro cyangwa azimye (umutuku iyo uteze amatwi). porogaramu gusa
help.help_32: SOS: beeps S-O-S muri code ya Morse kugirango uhamagare ubufasha.
help.help_34: Ukunzwe: ongera ibiri mubisanduku byanditse kubyo ukunda.
help.help_36: Hindura: ihindura uburyo bwo Guhindura no kuzimya (reba Guhindura).
help.help_40: Sangira inyandiko iri mu gasanduku (urugero mu butumwa).
help.help_42: Amagambo yashyizwe mu byiciro ibyiciro. Kanda icyiciro kugirango urebe interuro zacyo; Byose byerekana interuro yose.
help.help_43: Kuri terefone ifashe neza, kanda Ibyiciro hejuru yinteruro kugirango uhitemo imwe.
help.help_44: Ibikunzwe bifata interuro ukoresha cyane. Ongeraho imwe hamwe na ♡ buto, cyangwa tike Ibyo ukunda mugihe uhindura interuro.
help.help_45: Ihanagura (cyangwa umuzingo) urutonde kugirango ubone byinshi.
help.help_46: Kuri ecran nini, kurura umurongo hagati yinkingi zombi kugirango ugire ubugari.
help.help_48: Kanda it Hindura. Buri nteruro nicyiciro bibona ✎ buto, na "+ Ongera interuro" / "+ Ongera icyiciro" bigaragara hejuru yurutonde.
help.help_49: Mubwanditsi urashobora guhindura amagambo, ikimenyetso (andika cyangwa wandike emoji), shortcut, kandi ibyiciro birimo.
help.help_52: Muburyo bwo Guhindura, kurura ⠿ ikiganza kuri reord interuro cyangwa ibyiciro.
help.help_56: Kanda 🎙 hanyuma TexCom yumve umuntu muganira. Ibyo bavuga bigaragara hejuru ya ecran, kandi TexCom irashobora gutanga ibisubizo. porogaramu gusa
help.help_57: Igenamiterere> Smart AI> Tangira kumva iyo TexCom ifunguye ihindura mikoro igihe cyose utangiye TexCom.
help.help_58: Hamwe na clavier ihujwe, undi muntu arashobora gukanda ` urufunguzo (kuruhande rwa 1 cyangwa Z), andika, hanyuma ukande Injira. Amagambo yabo agaragara hejuru ya ecran. Esc guhagarika.
help.help_59: Kuri terefone yabo cyangwa mudasobwa yabo, ahantu hose
help.help_60: Igenamiterere> Ikiganiro> Tangira ikiganiro… iguha ihuza hamwe na code. Sangira ihuza (mubutumwa cyangwa imeri), cyangwa ubareke basuzume kode ya QR.
help.help_61: Bashobora gukoresha terefone iyo ari yo yose cyangwa mudasobwa (bafungura gusa umurongo), cyangwa TexCom yabo (Injira mu kiganiro…, hanyuma wandike umurongo cyangwa wandike kode).
help.help_62: Iyo bagerageje kwinjiramo, TexCom irakubaza: Emerera cyangwa Kugabanuka. Ntamuntu winjira utabivuze. Buri kiganiro gifite umurongo mushya.
help.help_63: Ibyo uvuga bigaragara binini cyane kuri ecran yabo. Ibyo bandika bigaragara mu mateka y’ikiganiro yawe.
help.help_64: Akabari kari hejuru y'ibiganiro kerekana uwo muvugana. Kanda Kurangiza kugirango urangize.
help.help_65: Soma ubutumwa bw'abafatanyabikorwa mu ijwi riranguruye (Igenamiterere> Ikiganiro) rikubwira ubutumwa bwabo.
help.help_68: Igenamiterere> Smart AI> Erekana amateka yo kuganira yerekana ikiganiro kugeza ubu, munsi yibyiciro (cyangwa hejuru yimvugo kuri terefone ifashe neza). Burigihe byerekana mugihe cyo kuganira kuri enterineti.
help.help_69: Kurura umurongo hejuru yacyo kugirango ube munini cyangwa muto.
help.help_71: Ibi bikorera wenyine kubikoresho byawe (Apple Intelligence), ntakintu rero uvuga cyoherejwe ahantu hose. Bakeneye iPhone, iPad cyangwa Mac.
help.help_72: Ibitekerezo byatanzwe: nyuma yuko wowe cyangwa mugenzi wawe uvuze, ibisubizo bigera kuri bitatu bigaragara hejuru yurutonde rwimvugo, byashyizweho 🧠. Kanda imwe kugirango uyikoreshe. Andika ^ kugirango ubaze ibyifuzo bishya.
help.help_73: Ijambo rikurikira-guhanura: nkuko wanditse, birashoboka ko amagambo akurikira agaragara nka buto. Kanda imwe kugirango wongere.
help.help_74: Kwagura Ubwenge: andika inyandiko ngufi hanyuma uyirangize hamwe na @ (urugero ukeneye kunywa @) maze TexCom irabyandika nkinteruro yuzuye. Zifungura muri Igenamiterere> Ubwenge bwa AI.
help.help_78: Imvugo: hitamo ijwi, ijwi, umuvuduko nubunini, hanyuma ukande Ijwi ryikizamini kugirango ubyumve.
help.help_80: Data: gutumiza interuro muri dosiye yinyandiko, fungura cyangwa ubike interuro yashizweho, cyangwa uyisangire.
help.help_82: Kuvugurura TexCom ntizigera ihinduka cyangwa ngo ikureho interuro yawe, ibyiciro cyangwa igenamiterere.
help.help_83: Iyo ivugurura rizanye interuro nshya, TexCom irakubwira rimwe, na Igenamiterere> Amakuru yerekana Ongeramo amagambo mashya ya TexCom…. Bajya mubice interuro nshya kugirango ubone. Komeza abo ukunda hanyuma usibe ibisigaye.
help.help_84: Kugirango ubike kopi, cyangwa wimure interuro yawe mubindi bikoresho, koresha Igenamiterere> Amakuru> Kubika interuro yashizweho… na Gufungura interuro….
